courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
related.titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
related.transfer: 可遷移「混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼」與「現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；斜張索雨風振動抑制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span" and "Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以近塔混凝土、跨中鋼箱梁的混合主梁與倒 Y 形塔，把斜張橋跨徑推進到 856 m；斜張索雨風振動抑制則以以水線氣動機制、史庫頓數、表面處理、阻尼器與交叉索，診斷並抑制斜索的雨風振動為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pushing the cable-stayed span to 856 m with a hybrid concrete-near-pylon, steel-at-midspan deck and inverted-Y pylons; Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables centres on diagnosing and suppressing rain–wind stay vibration through rivulet aerodynamics, Scruton number, surface treatment, dampers and cross-ties, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」與「上緣水線」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到斜張索雨風振動抑制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Central 624 m steel box” and “Upper water rivulet”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 諾曼第大橋
history.text: 為連接勒阿弗爾與翁弗勒爾、跨越塞納河口，勒阿弗爾工商會推動興建諾曼第大橋，由 Michel Virlogeux 主導設計，Bouygues 的 Bernard Raspaud 負責總體研究，1988 年起施工、1994 年完成主體，1995 年 1 月 20 日通車。當時 856 m 的主跨比前一紀錄長逾 250 m，靠的是混合主梁、倒 Y 形塔與流線形箱梁，CSTB 則提供現地風量測與氣動研究；1999 年跨徑紀錄被日本多多羅大橋打破。通車後長索振動促成阻尼器加裝，成為斜索防振的重要案例。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: To cross the Seine estuary between Le Havre and Honfleur, the Le Havre Chamber of Commerce and Industry promoted the Pont de Normandie, designed under Michel Virlogeux with general studies led by Bernard Raspaud of Bouygues; construction began in 1988, the main works were finished in 1994 and the bridge opened on 20 January 1995. Its 856 m span beat the previous record by more than 250 m thanks to the hybrid deck, inverted-Y pylons and a streamlined box, with CSTB providing site wind measurements and aerodynamic studies; Japan’s Tatara Bridge took the span record in 1999. Long-stay vibration after opening led to retrofitted dampers, making the bridge a key case in stay vibration control. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
